verdict.rationale: First-party docs explicitly claim cloud agents 'use their own computers to build, test, and demo features end to end for you to review,' plus supporting features like parallel agent fleets and background/scheduled agents, directly matching the story. However, there is no independent or hands-on evidence confirming this works reliably in practice, and community feedback focuses on bugginess and support issues rather than validating this specific capability. Missing for 10: independent verification of an agent autonomously building/testing/demoing a full feature, and details on how the demo/review handoff actually works.
